change: Make the workshop scan a durable Powerhouse and portal acquisition lineage instead of a PDF-only completion.
root_cause: The workshop scan generated a strong visible result and PDF but the scan completion still relied on the lead-mail path. The canonical Powerhouse scan store and the existing portal-local nulmeting handoff were not populated by /scan.
prevention_rule: Every completed /scan must create one idempotent submission key, persist a no-PII canonical scan event through /api/powerhouse-scan-ingest, write the compatible browser-local scan package for the portal, preserve workshop attribution, and route the PDF/result CTA into the portal. Lead delivery remains separate and consented.
privacy_rule: Do not copy participant name or e-mail into aggregate Powerhouse scan events. Identity linking happens only after verified account/organisation context is available.

historical_replay: A PDF-only workshop result could be downloaded while the Powerhouse scan history remained unaware of the participant's nulmeting.
The portal already knew how to start from bg_scan_pakket, but /scan did not populate that canonical browser handoff.
The canonical scan ingest already had idempotency and claim semantics, but it accepted only /frisse-blik.
